findings.desc: quality-cleanup: packages/main/src/cli-engine.ts:869-878 (renderDerived) and :890-894 (realRender) use untyped bare catch blocks around store.readChecklist/readStory/readMilestoneLedger that swallow ALL errors (including JSON.parse SyntaxError from a corrupted checklist.json/index.json/milestone-ledger.json), not just the intended "file not found" case. Repro: write a valid story with a corrupt checklist.json ("{ not json") and run `summary_set` (a command that never touches checklist.json) — it succeeds and silently prints "(no checklist items)" / Progress 0/0/0 instead of the CHK-002-mandated visible "⚠ Milestone Ledger: render FAILED" block. This directly contradicts the storys own stated goal (CHK-002: replace silent catches with a visible stdout failure block) — real data corruption is masked as an empty story instead of surfacing via visibleFailure(). Fix: catch only StoryArtifactMissingError (already exported/used elsewhere in store.ts, e.g. readMilestoneLedger/readBugs) and rethrow other errors so they reach the outer try/catch -> visibleFailure() path.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in 6263680: realRender no longer catches readMilestoneLedger (corrupt ledger now throws to visibleFailure); renderDerived only swallows StoryArtifactMissingError and rethrows JSON parse errors. Added a corrupt-milestone-ledger.json CLI regression test asserting the visible ⚠ block appears while exit stays 0. Verified: node packages/main/tests/milestone-status.test.mjs → ok; manual corrupt-ledger repro shows the ⚠ block.
